description: Docs CMS Plugin + Guest Pages + Admin Dashboard + User Dashboard - Complete frontend and backend for content management, public pages, and both dashboard layouts
steps: Create internal/plugins/docs/plugin.go: Implement Plugin interface. Name()='docs'. Register admin routes (CRUD) and public routes (read-only).

Create internal/plugins/docs/models.go: Post struct (ID, Title, Slug, ContentMD, ContentHTML, Excerpt, Status enum draft/published, CategoryID, AuthorID, PublishedAt, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt). Category struct (ID, Name, Slug, Description). Tag struct (ID, Name, Slug). PostTag struct (PostID, TagID).

Create internal/plugins/docs/repository.go: Post CRUD (create, get by ID, get by slug, list with filters, update, delete, publish, unpublish), Category CRUD, Tag CRUD, PostTag associations, full-text search, pagination.

Create internal/plugins/docs/handlers.go: Admin - GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /posts, POST /posts/:id/publish, POST /posts/:id/unpublish, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /categories, GET/POST/DELETE /tags. Public - GET /docs (list published), GET /docs/:slug (by slug), GET /docs/search?q= (search).
Create internal/plugins/docs/markdown.go: Markdown to HTML conversion using goldmark with syntax highlighting extension (github.com/yuin/goldmark, github.com/yuin/goldmark-highlighting).
Create internal/plugins/docs/migrations/: 001_create_categories.up.sql, 002_create_posts.up.sql, 003_create_tags.up.sql, 004_create_post_tags.up.sql. All with down migrations.
Create internal/plugins/docs/migrate.go: Embed and execute migrations.
Update internal/plugins/registry.go to register docs plugin.
Create ui/src/plugins/docs/api.ts: API functions for post CRUD, category/tag CRUD, public docs listing/detail/search.
Create ui/src/plugins/docs/types.ts: TypeScript types for Post, Category, Tag, search params.
Create ui/src/routes/_guest/index.tsx: Landing page - hero section (headline, subheadline, CTA button), features grid (6 cards with icons from lucide-react), brief testimonials section, footer.
Create ui/src/routes/_guest/pricing.tsx: Pricing page - plan comparison cards fetched from /api/v1/plans/available. Show name, price, features list, CTA. Highlight Pro plan.
Create ui/src/routes/_guest/docs/index.tsx: Docs listing - card grid of published posts from /api/v1/docs. Search input, category filter.
Create ui/src/routes/_guest/docs/$slug.tsx: Doc detail - rendered HTML content, table of contents from headings, back navigation.

Create ui/src/routes/_admin.tsx: Admin layout - sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Users, Roles, Plans, Content, Settings), top bar with user info and logout. Protected by role check (redirect if not admin).
Create ui/src/routes/_admin/index.tsx: Admin overview - stats cards (total users, active plans, published docs), recent activity list, quick action buttons.
Create ui/src/routes/_admin/roles.tsx: Role management - list roles with user count.
Create ui/src/routes/_admin/content.tsx: Content management - post list table with status filter, create/edit functionality with markdown textarea, category/tag selection.
Create ui/src/routes/_admin/settings.tsx: Admin settings page - site configuration form.
Create ui/src/routes/_dashboard.tsx: User dashboard layout - simpler navigation (Overview, Profile, Subscription, Settings), user avatar and name, logout.
Create ui/src/routes/_dashboard/index.tsx: User overview - welcome message, subscription status card, quick links.
Add Go dependencies: github.com/yuin/goldmark, github.com/yuin/goldmark-highlighting/v2 (or appropriate highlighting package).
Ensure go build ./... passes, go vet ./... passes, cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit passes, cd ui && npm run build passes.
acceptance_criteria: cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit exits with code 0
cd ui && npm run build exits with code 0
Docs plugin registers CRUD + public endpoints
Markdown rendering with syntax highlighting works
Guest pages (landing, pricing, docs) compile and render
Admin dashboard layout with sidebar navigation compiles
All routes are properly typed with TanStack Router
